nodes_added_or_strengthened: Received Sui-attributed work's two annual-life method families and China-Japan bibliographic coverage in the outlines
edges_rejected_or_unproved: Fixed sixjia sequence does not prove direct transmission into Ziping
Dunjia star-name vocabulary does not identify Ziwei star placement
Separate 1897/1899 date labels are not independently verified physical impressions
unresolved_lineage_questions: Original manuscript/printed target leaves, age-count anchor, source edition dependencies, and transmission between early annual-life methods and Song/Ming Xiaoyun.
